video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Coach Nurse | 10.13.26

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the 76ers' recent practice intensity and participation
quotes.excerpt: they did a good majority of stuff in the half court
quotes.quote: They did a good majority of stuff in the half court. There was no scrimmaging or full court work, but a majority of it and there was a pretty good chunk of time spent in the half court today, so they got a good section of practice in.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the Sixers focused on half court work during practice today but held off on any full court scrimmaging.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the importance of Joel Embiid and Anthony Melton returning
quotes.excerpt: two big additions if they could both come back for sure
quotes.quote: I think it's important. We know what we got with Joel Embiid and Anthony Melton is obviously a seasoned veteran player, so two big additions if they could both come back for sure.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse calls the potential return of Joel Embiid and Anthony Melton two big additions for the Sixers as they look to get healthy.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the status of Paul George's injury recovery
quotes.excerpt: he just has some soreness that he's dealing with
quotes.quote: There is no timeline. He just has some soreness that he's dealing with. Giving him some real decent time off to see if that will progress it quickly. There's no timeline, just hoping it gets a little better and he feels a little better and can get back out there fairly shortly.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse confirms there is no timeline for Paul George to return from his soreness. The team is giving him time off to see if he can progress quickly.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the 76ers' performance in preseason games
quotes.excerpt: there was some moments of really good play and then there was some moments of not very good play
quotes.quote: There was some moments of really good play and then there was some moments of not very good play and some stuff that was fairly clunky and spacing was on top of each other. But there was certainly some really good moments. Mostly getting guys out there and getting them doing stuff and then starting to go to work from there.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse admits the Sixers preseason play has been clunky at times with spacing issues but says there have been some really good moments to build on.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on Tyrese Maxey's increased offensive workload
quotes.excerpt: he's had to generate so much by himself
quotes.quote: I think that he's had to generate so much by himself, bringing it up, lots of dribbles, lots of ball screens, find the space, bounce around, find some more space, make a bunch of reads. He should get a good chunk of either guys creating for him a little bit more or quick off one or two one off-ball action that gets him freed up too.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse wants to reduce Tyrese Maxey's heavy offensive workload by finding ways to get him easier looks off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the strong play of Guerschon Yabusele and Andre Drummond
quotes.excerpt: I think Guerschon Yabusele has played outstanding actually
quotes.quote: They've both played pretty good. I think Guerschon Yabusele has played outstanding actually. That's great and I think Andre Drummond we've seen that he's a really good player, kind of multifaceted guy that can guard, he can pop, he can guard multiple positions, he rebounds really well for his position.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse is impressed with the early play of the Sixers bench, calling Guerschon Yabusele outstanding and highlighting Andre Drummond as a multifaceted contributor.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the rotation battle between Guerschon Yabusele and Andre Drummond
quotes.excerpt: I envision those three, Paul George, Tyrese Maxey, Anthony Melton, sharing that spot as much as possible
quotes.quote: I think they're different players. The competition is who's the guard off the bench in that rotation. I'm going to lean towards a nine-year veteran as long as he's healthy. I envision those three, Paul George, Tyrese Maxey, Anthony Melton, sharing that spot as much as possible and then Andre Drummond gets a crack in probably pretty short stints at the start.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse outlines his rotation plan, noting he will lean on veteran experience and expects Andre Drummond to see short stints at the start of games.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the rebounding philosophy for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: everybody's got to take care of their guy
quotes.quote: Everybody's got to take care of their guy and then you make reads on who's getting backed. Your rovers can get in there and help if your guy's back and you don't have everybody to take care of. It changes a little bit. There's certain bigs that are such a handful that you absolutely have to send somebody from the outside to try to rebound over the top of them.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse on the Sixers rebounding philosophy: Everyone has to take care of their guy, but some bigs are such a handful you have to send help.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the impact of rebounding on zone defense
quotes.excerpt: it's harder to rebound out of a zone for sure
quotes.quote: It's harder to rebound out of a zone for sure because you're playing areas and nobody's accounting for particular guys. You got to do a lot more looking to find a body and looking for a little bit more communication of who's taking who out of a zone than you do man. That's why it is harder to rebound out of a zone.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse explains why rebounding out of a zone defense is difficult, noting that it requires more communication to find bodies compared to man defense.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the 76ers' identity and team goals
quotes.excerpt: we need to play intelligent basketball
quotes.quote: I think we need to play intelligent basketball. I think we got some veteran guys and some guys that can really pass, space, do some things that should look like we're getting the shots we want. First and foremost, I'm going to hope that they're playing with tremendous effort. When you leave, you ought to know they gave everything they had that night to try to get a W.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the Sixers identity needs to be built on intelligent basketball and tremendous effort every single night.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on his expectations for Paul George's defensive role
quotes.excerpt: I want him to rebound his position and I want him to protect the rim
quotes.quote: I'm always kind of looking for the same from him. I want him to rebound his position and I want him to protect the rim. He's really been out on the court and working hard, he's playing hard. He played hard, man, and that's where he keeps playing hard, things are going to like the defensive rebounds and the rim protection and other good putbacks on offense.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says he is looking for Paul George to rebound his position and protect the rim as he works his way back into the rotation.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on balancing a set rotation with emerging players
quotes.excerpt: the balance would be shifted pretty heavily towards wanting the rotation
quotes.quote: The balance would be shifted pretty heavily towards wanting the rotation. I'd love it if those guys were whatever number they end up and they don't crack the rotation. I'd like that to happen for a long time if possible, but I understand the reality of they're going to get shifted in there because of how things unfold over the season.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says he would love for his set rotation to stay intact but acknowledges the reality that emerging players will shift into the mix over the season.

quotes.speaker: Nick Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse on the difficulty of defending in scrimmage settings
quotes.excerpt: it's early is what I'm observing
quotes.quote: It's early is what I'm observing. You obviously see some really good things. You see some timing on some cuts. You see these guys reading situations. We're letting things unfold a little bit late game in practice and watching kind of what they're seeing and where they're heading with the ball. It's hard to defend because you got a lot of guys that can score the basketball.
quotes.social_post: Nick Nurse says the Sixers offense is hard to defend in practice because they have so many guys who can score the basketball.
